build_semseg_evaluator: build a SemSegEvaluator instance for a named dataset with optional output directory and distributed mode
process_semseg_predictions: process model inputs and semantic segmentation outputs to accumulate confusion matrix and predictions
evaluate_semseg_metrics: evaluate semantic segmentation metrics including mIoU, fwIoU, mACC, and pACC from accumulated predictions
encode_json_semseg: encode a semantic segmentation prediction array into COCO stuff format JSON with RLE-encoded masks
reset_semseg_evaluator: reset the SemSegEvaluator confusion matrix and predictions list to start a new evaluation round
